thread:
anna: FYI — NimbusWorks agreed to a short customer case + webinar mention. Needs: 1) 1-line exec quote, 2) legal consent for clips/logo, 3) recording slot, 4) webinar sign-up routing. Brief: https://drive.redwood.com/nimbus-brief

mike-cs: I can run the call. Available Mon/Tue mornings PT. Will prep three talking points: cost, latency, integration time. 20-25m should be enough.

zoe-prod: Producer here — Tue 9:30am PT open. I'll set Zoom + Otter, capture transcript, plan 75s social cut + 20s teaser. Request hi-res logo and headshot.

leah-sales: For routing: need utm_campaign=nimbus-launch, hidden product_interest=nimbus, SF queue = SDR_Nimbus. Will add tag "nimbus_webinar". Also want a rule to assign enterprise leads to AE_Nimbus.

harry-legal: Legal needs explicit consent text listing uses (case page, social, webinar repurpose). Metrics must include measurement window and be described as "aggregated production workload". No comparative vendor claims. Paste final quote + consent here for review.

anna: Draft quote to propose: "NimbusWorks cut our inference costs by ~43% and reduced p95 from ~810ms to ~240ms on our July production workload." Consent template: "By approving this quote, NimbusWorks grants Redwood Inference permission to publish the quote and related materials (transcript excerpts, short video clips, and summary statistics) for marketing and sales purposes."

zoe-prod: Suggest asking for a 1-sentence hero variant during the call. Also confirm they approve the 75s cut + 20s teaser.

mike-cs: I'll ask for a 1-line hero, logo, and consent on the call and paste their reply here.

ops-bot: Reminder: submit /legal-review with final quote + consent. SLA 48h.

harry-legal: If only aggregated metrics were provided, no DPA required. If they provided raw logs, we need a DPA + security questionnaire.

leah-sales: I'll wire up the form fields and SF queue today. Confirm SF queue name and AE rule once live.

mike-cs: Reached out to NimbusWorks; they'll provide a short quote + logo after the call.

anna: Action items:
- Mike: capture 1-line quote + logo + consent on call (due EOD Tue)
- Zoe: calendar + recording + promo edit plan (invite sent)
- Leah: implement form fields + SF routing (SDR_Nimbus + product_interest + utm)
- Harry: legal review once quote submitted (48h SLA)

leah-sales: Updated — form + utm set, SF queue SDR_Nimbus created, AE rule added.

harry-legal: I'll watch for the /legal-review ticket and aim to clear within 48h. If they request embargo, include dates in consent.

anna: Great. Timeline: publish case page the week after next, social promo same day, webinar ~7-10 days post-publish if legal signs off.

ops-bot: Task created: "NimbusWorks case + legal review" assigned to harry-legal, due in 48h after submission."
